title: Brazilian Paneer Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Brazilian-inspired curry made with paneer, perfect for a quick dinner. Serve with rice or naan for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat the ghee or oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and ginger, and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the paneer and cook until it starts to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the sambal, broth, and coconut milk, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to low and cook for 10-15 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt to taste, then serve hot over rice or with naan.
